versions.changelog: Clearer controls and disclosures from the 0.1.0/0.1.1 reviews: the description now mentions the optional, user-requested Dongwo import; install --no-onboard now turns the first-use quiz prompt off for good; docs state that forget revokes a signal but keeps its log line (delete ~/.xtaste to erase); README no longer implies every phrase is recorded; agent context separates xtaste's own status lines from user taste data. 控制与说明更清楚：--no-onboard 可彻底关闭测试提示；如实说明 forget 只撤销、不抹除。

English version: the quiz, profile and agent context follow your system language (中文 / English), with a 中/EN switch on the quiz page. Security: the local quiz server now only accepts requests addressed to 127.0.0.1/localhost and carrying a per-session token, fixing a DNS-rebinding issue found in the 0.1.0 scan. 新增英文版，按系统语言自动选择；修复 0.1.0 扫描发现的 DNS 重绑定问题。
首个版本：5 分钟本机测试打底，之后从你的每次反馈中学习品味；覆盖视觉、文案、命名、代码、做事方式、产品取舍 29 个维度 + 参照锚点。Remember your taste once — every AI after that knows it.
